programme.desc: Journey through Ethiopia’s sacred landmarks-where faith carved stone, shaped empires, and legends like the Ark of the Covenant still stir the soul.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia - Pozarevac, Serbia
programme.desc: While exploring the ruins of a powerful Roman settlement in Viminacium, Heather stumbles upon the remains of a million-year-old female woolly mammoth.

programme.title: Unbound - Soca Valley, Slovenia
programme.desc: Slovenia’s Soca Valley, a land of aquamarine river rapids and dense emerald forests, was once part of the bloodiest frontlines of the First World War.

programme.title: See My Home California - Yosemite
programme.desc: Join Genevieve on a scenic journey to Yosemite, with a charming detour through Carmel-by-the-Sea.

programme.title: Xplore Philippines - Manila
programme.desc: The stone-walled dungeons of Fort Santiago, in Manila, were once witnesses of the most gruesome events in Philippine history.

programme.title: 50 States Tennessee - Nashville
programme.desc: Nashville doesn’t ask Iona if she likes music. It just starts playing.

programme.title: City Breaks - Salzburg
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici explores the Baroque splendor and musical heritage of Salzburg, the cultural capital of Austria.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia - Majdanpek, Serbia
programme.desc: Heather explores Serbia’s largest national park, the Djerdap National Park, where she finds herself transfixed with the astounding Iron Gates gorge.

programme.title: Unbound - Piran, Slovenia
programme.desc: In Piran and Portoroz, two beautiful towns on the Slovenian Riviera, Sabrina peels back the layers of the country’s rich heritage.

programme.title: See My Home California - Big Sur
programme.desc: Join Genevieve, a California native, on an insider's journey through the Golden State's hidden gems and iconic landmarks.

programme.title: Xplore Philippines - Bohol
programme.desc: Elisha heads to Bohol, in Philippines, to see the unique Chocolate Hills consisting of 1268 hills that are mysteriously identical in shape.

programme.title: 50 States Tennessee - The Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: The Smokies don’t speak. They breathe - and Iona finally slows down enough to listen.

programme.title: City Breaks - Innsbruck
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici explores the Alpine charm as well as the Habsburg Empire heritage in Innsbruck, the capital of Austria’s Tyrol province.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia - Nis, Serbia
programme.desc: Heather visits the site of the first mass escape in occupied Europe at Niš, where she comes to know the story of an impossibly daring prison break.

programme.title: Unbound - Koper, Slovenia
programme.desc: From Praetorian Palace to Tito Square, the iconic attractions of Koper offer Sabrina glimpses into the history of Slovenia.

programme.title: See My Home California - San Diego
programme.desc: From sea caves to celebrity sidewalks, Genevieve rides the waves of California’s contrasts.

programme.title: Xplore Philippines - Cebu
programme.desc: The Boracay island of Philippines has all the right ingredients for a fun day: sugar-white beaches, water adventures and live Filipino music.

programme.title: 50 States Tennessee - Chattanooga & Beyond
programme.desc: Chattanooga sneaks up on Iona and becomes her favorite surprise of the trip.

programme.title: City Breaks - Frankfurt
programme.desc: Christina is in Frankfurt and receives light shower rains.She decides to beat the rains and head out to one of the smaller towns.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia - Resavsk Pecina, Serbia
programme.desc: From the murals of a monastery in Despotovac to a 19th century experience in Zlatibor, Heather soaks in Serbia’s cultural vivacity.

programme.title: Unbound - Ljubljana, Slovenia
programme.desc: ‘Ljubljeni’ means beloved in Slovene. Sabrina’s last stop on her trip is the capital city, Ljubljana which, much like Slovenia, has love in its name.

programme.title: All I Want for Christmas - All I Want for Christmas
programme.desc: Ukrainian war refugee, Ksenia takes her daughter, Anastasia, to Finland for a magical Christmas, hoping to rekindle her joy and sense of wonder.

programme.title: Heritage - Sigiriya
programme.desc: Sigiriya or the site of the 'Lion Mountain in Sri Lanka is a majestic fortress.With brilliant frescoes painted in the galleries and staircases which emerge from the mouth of the gigantic lion.

programme.title: Landmarks - Pampalmousse Garden
programme.desc: Mighty mountains, cascading waterfalls, exotic forests, impressive cliffs - the dramatic landscape of Mauritius is explained by the fact that Mauritius is an island of volcanic origin.

programme.title: World Heritage - Ethiopian Monuments of Faith
programme.desc: Journey through Ethiopia’s sacred landmarks-where faith carved stone, shaped empires, and legends like the Ark of the Covenant still stir the soul.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia - Sjenica, Serbia
programme.desc: Heather visits the stunning Uvac canyons, where she encounters the rare griffon vulture and takes a boat ride to a secret cave.

programme.title: Unwind - The Palace, Dubai
programme.desc: From the world’s largest mall to a magical desert safari, the host realizes that Dubai is one of the world's most glamorous destinations.

programme.title: Bliss - Sunny Beach, Bulgaria
programme.desc: Kirsty Nichol feasts her eyes on local Bulgarian art at the Helena Resort in Sunny Beach. She also enjoys jet skiing and some delicious local fare.

programme.title: Best From The Rest - River Rafting In India
programme.desc: We have got the ultimate guide to India’s best white-water rafting spots, whether you’re a rookie or a river-riding pro!

programme.title: Costa Rica Calling - Turrialba
programme.desc: In the Turrialba region, Genevieve finds herself in awe of the highest volcano in Costa Rica, its active presence quickening her pulse.

programme.title: 50 States Florida - Miami
programme.desc: Miami doesn’t slowly introduce itself to Iona. It turns the volume all the way up

programme.title: Backpack Serbia - Belgrade,Serbia
programme.desc: While exploring Belgrade, Heather goes on an underground tour where she stumbles onto some mysterious old tunnels.

programme.title: Unbound - Bled, Slovenia
programme.desc: With its medieval castle and breathtaking lake, Bled is like something out of a dream; why then did the owners of the castle rarely live there?

programme.title: 50 States Florida - Orlando
programme.desc: Orlando surprises Iona by being a lot more interesting than just theme parks.

programme.title: Unbound - Radovljica, Slovenia
programme.desc: Sabrina visits a quaint town with mountain views and medieval houses, where people make chocolates, red gingerbread hearts and honey.

programme.title: Costa Rica Calling - Manuel Antonio
programme.desc: In the Manuel Antonio region of Costa Rica, Genevieve’s quest for wildlife leads her from rainforest to ocean.

programme.title: World Heritage - Abandoned City of Champaner, India
programme.desc: The pre-Mughal Islamic architecture of Champaner and the Rajput temples of Pavagadh have earned them the title, "University of Architecture".

programme.title: See My Home California - Shasta County
programme.desc: Discover the natural splendour of Shasta County with its majestic forests, mysterious caves, and tranquil lakes.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia - Novi Sad, Serbia
programme.desc: From a canoe ride on the Danube river to new flavours at the local market, Heather explores the sassy side of Serbia’s second largest city.

programme.title: 50 States Florida - Orlando
programme.desc: Orlando surprises Iona by being a lot more interesting than just theme parks.

programme.title: Unbound - Radovljica, Slovenia
programme.desc: Sabrina visits a quaint town with mountain views and medieval houses, where people make chocolates, red gingerbread hearts and honey.

programme.title: The King Of Snooker - EP15
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP5
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Unchained Medley - EP10
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life.

programme.title: Rosy Business - EP21
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI’s (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon - EP32
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins.

programme.title: Food Of Love - EP1
programme.desc: Gifted cooking talent Tak (Wong Hei) wants to be a successful chef. He does not give up even when his father Kin (Leung Ka Yan) is against the idea. His uncle Kwai (Lau Kar Fai) is on his side and finally Tak is given a chance to learn in a Chinese restaurant in a hotel. There he meets his dream girl Wing (Kennix Kwok) and wins her heart. Tak’s best friend Lam (Fennie Yuen) is upset when she learns about this.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP12
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories - EP7
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long’s two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei’s (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP10
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP11

programme.title: The Conquest - EP3
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered.

programme.title: The King Of Snooker - EP16
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP6
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Unchained Medley - EP11
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life.

programme.title: Rosy Business - EP22
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI’s (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife.

programme.title: Food Of Love - EP2
programme.desc: Gifted cooking talent Tak (Wong Hei) wants to be a successful chef. He does not give up even when his father Kin (Leung Ka Yan) is against the idea. His uncle Kwai (Lau Kar Fai) is on his side and finally Tak is given a chance to learn in a Chinese restaurant in a hotel. There he meets his dream girl Wing (Kennix Kwok) and wins her heart. Tak’s best friend Lam (Fennie Yuen) is upset when she learns about this.
